CharacterSoundUtils.luau.description: Utility for replacing default Roblox character sounds with custom sounds. Replaces sounds like: - Death - Running/Walking - Jumping - Landing - Swimming - Climbing - Falling - Getting Up - Splash - FreeFalling Public entry points include `CharacterSoundUtils.waitForSoundsLoadedAsync`, `CharacterSoundUtils.replaceSound`, `CharacterSoundUtils.replaceSounds`, `CharacterSoundUtils.replaceAllSounds`,…

CharacterUtils.luau.description: General character utility code. Public entry points include `CharacterUtils.setReplicationId`, `CharacterUtils.getByReplicationId`, `CharacterUtils.getPlayerHumanoid`, `CharacterUtils.getAlivePlayerHumanoid`, `CharacterUtils.getAlivePlayerRootPart`, `CharacterUtils.getPlayerRootPart`, `CharacterUtils.unequipTools`, `CharacterUtils.getPlayerFromCharacter`.

DisableHatParticles.luau.description: Disable Hat Particles provides the class/model implementation used by the Characterutils package. Public entry points include `DisableHatParticles.new`.

R15Utils.luau.description: Utility methods for R15 Characters. R15 is a specific Roblox character specification. Public entry points include `R15Utils.isAnimationConstraintOrMotor6D`, `R15Utils.searchForRigAttachment`, `R15Utils.getRigMotor`, `R15Utils.getUpperTorso`, `R15Utils.getLowerTorso`, `R15Utils.getBodyPart`, `R15Utils.getWaistJoint`, `R15Utils.getNeckJoint`.

RxCharacterUtils.luau.description: Utilities for observing characters and their humanoids. Public entry points include `RxCharacterUtils.observeLastCharacterBrio`, `RxCharacterUtils.observeCharacter`, `RxCharacterUtils.observeCharacterBrio`, `RxCharacterUtils.observeIsOfLocalCharacter`, `RxCharacterUtils.observeIsOfLocalCharacterBrio`, `RxCharacterUtils.observeLocalPlayerCharacter`, `RxCharacterUtils.observeLastHumanoidBrio`,…

RxHumanoidUtils.luau.description: Rx Humanoid Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Characterutils package. Public entry points include `RxHumanoidUtils.observeRunningSpeed`, `emitRunningSpeed`, `RxHumanoidUtils.observeHumanoidStateType`, `emitStateType`, `RxHumanoidUtils.observeHumanoidHealth`, `RxHumanoidUtils.observeHumanoidHealthAsBrio`.

RxR15Utils.luau.description: Utility methods to query components of an R15 character. Public entry points include `RxR15Utils.observeRigAttachmentBrio`, `RxR15Utils.observeRigMotorBrio`, `RxR15Utils.observeRigWeldBrio`, `RxR15Utils.observeCharacterPartBrio`, `RxR15Utils.observeHumanoidBrio`, `RxR15Utils.observeHumanoidScaleValueObject`, `RxR15Utils.observeHumanoidScaleProperty`, `RxR15Utils.observeShoulderRigAttachmentBrio`.

RxRootPartUtils.luau.description: Rx Root Part Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Characterutils package. Public entry points include `RxRootPartUtils.observeHumanoidRootPartBrio`, `RxRootPartUtils.observeHumanoidRootPartBrioFromHumanoid`.
